areas.title: Health and assistants
areas.intro: `ping` checks the connection. The two assistant tools run the same assistants as the OHLCX app and return plain text, not JSON. They call a language model, so they are slower than the data tools and their answers vary. For data you intend to process, call the data tools directly.
tools: Ask the support assistant, which answers from the knowledge base only. Returns plain text.
Ask the trading assistant, which reads the signed-in user's strategies, accounts and the knowledge base. Returns plain text.

areas.title: Knowledge base
areas.intro: Reading the knowledge base needs no sign-in. Writing it is for admins.
tools: Search or list knowledge base articles, optionally by area or by text.
Fetch one article by its slug.

areas.title: Accounts
areas.intro: Every tool here names an account by its account id and shows its number only as a masked label. Output shapes, the forms `account_id` accepts and the refusal for an account that is not yours are on [Accounts and identifiers](../accounts.md).
tools: The user's linked brokerage accounts: each account's id, masked label, type, flags and balances.
Daily balance history of every linked account in one call. The last 30 days unless `days` says otherwise.
Daily balance history of one account.
Profit and loss data for one account.
Realized profit and loss over time for one account, for a period or between two dates. Needs the user's consent to P&L sync, given in the app.
Realized profit and loss by symbol for one account, for a period or between two dates. Needs the user's consent to P&L sync, given in the app.
Deposits and withdrawals of one account, for a period or between two dates.

areas.title: Orders (read-only)
areas.intro: These two tools read broker orders. No tool places, changes or cancels an order. See [Accounts and identifiers](../accounts.md#orders).
tools: Broker orders placed between two dates, across the linked accounts or for one.
One broker order by its id, with its legs, fills and status.

areas.title: Strategies: reading
areas.intro: A strategy can be read only by the user who owns it. Paging and period filters are on [Limits and paging](../limits-and-paging.md).
tools: The user's strategies. Up to 50 without arguments; `page` or `per_page` asks for the paged list.
One strategy by id, with its order accounts under `routing`.
Search the user's strategies by symbol.
One strategy's trade statistics (counts, win rate, profit and loss) for a period.
Trade statistics across all of the user's strategies for a period.
One strategy's performance over time (the profit and loss series) for a period.
Performance over time across all of the user's strategies for a period.
What a strategy did, day by day, over the last days (7 by default).
The signals a strategy has raised, 100 per page.
The trades a strategy has taken, 100 per page.
The flags a strategy's conditions have raised, 100 per page.

areas.title: Strategies: changing
areas.intro: Read the `ohlcx://strategy-settings` resource before you create a strategy or change its settings. A deployed strategy refuses the changes marked below with "Retain the strategy before changing it.": retain it first. See [Strategies and order routing](../strategy-routing.md#the-deployed-lock).
tools: Create a strategy. `payload` needs the fields listed in the `ohlcx://strategy-settings` resource.
Update a strategy's definition by id. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Delete a strategy by id. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Update one section of a strategy's settings; each section is validated on its own. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Set the days and hours a strategy is allowed to run. Times are New York time. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Clear the reading of every condition of a strategy. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Delete all of a strategy's signals, trades or flags. Cannot be undone. Flags: refused while deployed. Signals: refused only while deployed, real and with orders on. Trades: never refused.

areas.title: Strategies: order routing and running
areas.intro: These tools decide whether a strategy runs, whether it sends orders, and to which accounts. They are walked through in order on [Strategies and order routing](../strategy-routing.md). Confirm each of them with the user first.
tools: The linked accounts as a strategy's orders can be routed to them: account id, masked label, whether the account can receive orders now and, if not, the reason.
Choose the order accounts of a strategy: mode `selected` with account ids, or mode `all`. Never switches orders on or off. Refused while the strategy is deployed.
Switch signals, trades or orders (or their notifications) on or off, or toggle them. On and toggle are refused while the strategy is deployed; off always works.
Switch a strategy on or off. On is refused while the strategy is deployed; off always works.
Deploy a strategy, so that the engine evaluates it.
Retain a strategy: take it out of evaluation, so that it can be changed again. With `stop` true it also switches orders, trades and signals off.

areas.title: Conditions
areas.intro: Conditions belong to a strategy. Writing one is refused while its strategy is deployed.
tools: Create a condition. Refused while its strategy is deployed.
Update a condition by id. Refused while its strategy is deployed.
Delete a condition by id. Refused while its strategy is deployed.

areas.title: Signals
tools: One signal by id, with its strategy and trades.
Delete a signal. Cannot be undone. Refused only while its strategy is deployed, real and has orders on.
Mark a signal for the user: like, unlike, ignore, unignore, watch or unwatch.
How the user has marked a signal: liked, ignored, watched.

areas.title: Trades
areas.intro: A trade here is OHLCX's record of what a strategy did. It is not a broker order.
tools: The trades taken by the user's strategies, 100 per page.
Delete a strategy trade from OHLCX's records. Does not close a position or cancel an order at the broker. Cannot be undone.

areas.title: Backtests
areas.intro: The first four tools read and manage saved runs. The last five start and follow server-side runs and are listed only where the app has server backtests switched on. At most three backtests may wait or run at once.
tools: The user's saved backtest runs, newest first, with each run's metrics.
One saved run: its period, settings, what-if overrides and metrics. The trade list, equity curve and strategy snapshot come only when named in `include`.
Delete a saved run. Cannot be undone.
Start a server-side backtest of a strategy as it is now. It runs in the background: poll `get-backtest-job`.
Start a parameter sweep: the strategy is backtested once for every combination of one or two settings, and the results are ranked.
The user's server-side backtests and sweeps, newest first, with status and progress.
One server-side job: its status, progress, and when finished the saved run's `backtest_id` (a run) or the ranked result (a sweep).
Cancel a server-side job that is still waiting or running.

areas.title: Workspaces
areas.intro: Workspaces are the user's saved layouts of charts and widgets. They are saved as one document against a revision.
tools: The user's Workspaces document, with the revision to send back when saving.
Save the whole Workspaces document against a revision. If it was changed somewhere else, nothing is saved and the current state and revision come back.

areas.title: Watchlists
areas.intro: These tools change the user's own watchlists. Built-in watchlists are listed but not changed.
tools: The user's watchlists with their symbols, the built-in watchlists, and which built-in ones the user has hidden.
Rename one of the user's watchlists.
Delete one of the user's watchlists and the symbols in it. Cannot be undone.
Add one or more symbols to a watchlist. Symbols already in it are kept once.
Remove one symbol from a watchlist.

areas.title: Markets and price data
tools: The available markets, or one market by id.
Ticker data for one symbol, or the tickers of one market.
A symbol's price bars (open, high, low, close, volume) on a timeframe. The most recent 200 unless told otherwise; follow `meta.next_cursor` for more.
The published analysis for one symbol, 10 per page.
Market balance data, with optional filters.
Sector balance chart data, with optional filters.

areas.title: Screeners
tools: The symbols of a market that gapped at the open, each with its size, plus the market's gap statistics for the session.
One symbol's history of gaps on a timeframe: each gap, the gap statistics, and the bars they were found in.
A market's symbols by their technical readings on a timeframe: moving averages, pivots and indicator signals, with the market's summary.

areas.title: Analysis and AI usage
tools: The user's AI analysis data (recent messages with attachments).
The user's AI assistant usage: requests and tokens by agent and by source, for a date range.

areas.title: Activities
tools: The user's activity feed. An account named in an activity appears only by its masked label.
Log an activity for the user.
Delete one of the user's activities by id.

areas.title: Credits and billing
tools: The user's credit balance and summary.
The user's billing and transaction history.
The user's credit holds, newest first: credits set aside for a staged-exit order, and whether each is still held, was captured or was released.

areas.title: Support
areas.intro: The four ticket tools are listed only where the app is connected to the support desk. Tickets and replies reach the support team: confirm the wording with the user first.
tools: The user's support tickets with their status.
One of the user's support tickets with its messages.
Open a support ticket with the OHLCX support team on behalf of the user.
Add a message from the user to one of their support tickets.

areas.title: Profile and settings
tools: The signed-in user: id, name, email and verification status. An admin may pass `user_id` to read another user.
Submit or update the user's onboarding data.

areas.title: Trading rooms and messages
tools: Update a trading room by id.
Delete a trading room by id.
Invite a user to a trading room.
The status of a trading room.
Trading rooms the user could join, optionally by name.
Other OHLCX users to message or invite to a trading room, optionally by name.
Answer a request to join a trading room.
The requests to join the user's own trading rooms that are still waiting for an answer.
Send a message in a trading room.
Load the messages before a given message.
The user's unread trading room and direct messages, by conversation.

areas.title: Administration
areas.intro: These tools are listed only for a signed-in admin. The knowledge base write tools, also for admins, are under [Knowledge base](#knowledge-base).
tools: List users, with optional search and paging.
Make a user an admin, or remove that.
Update a user's name, email, admin flag or email verification.
Permanently delete a user by id. You cannot delete your own user.
Billing information for a user. An account in it appears only by its masked label.
Adjust a user's credits or billing.
